intents.title: Establish AFWE-Core vs AFWE-Client contracts and protect AGENTS.md
intents.description: Establish formal dual-context separation between AFWE-Core (development) and AFWE-Client (production). Optimize AGENTS.md to mandate post-turn documentation, skills, and MCP synchronization. Prevent init and onboard from overwriting custom agent configurations, and detect self-repository to prevent stomping AFWE-Core AGENTS.md.

claims.statement: AFWE-Client contracts generated by render_agents_block exclusively reference .afwe/docs/ and the afwe skill
Root AGENTS.md explicitly documents AFWE-Core vs AFWE-Client separation, MCP tool update obligation, and skill update obligation
write_agents_block preserves existing non-AFWE contents in AGENTS.md and never overwrites entire files
